card.name: Start of organ-toxicity terms
card.fires_on: The opening piece of organ-toxicity words such as hepatotoxicity, neurologic or neuropathy, in warnings and dose-modification text. Also fires on 'liver' right after 'Monitor'.

modes.label: Hepat- start
modes.description: The first part of 'hepatotoxicity' before the rest of the word.
modes.example: Lapatinib has been associated with<< hepat>>otoxicity.

modes.label: Neuro- start
modes.description: The first part of 'neurologic' or 'neuropathy' in adverse reaction text.
modes.example: Discontinue nelarabine injection if the patient develops a<< neuro>>logic adverse reaction of NCI CTCA

modes.label: Liver monitoring
modes.description: The word liver after a monitoring instruction.
modes.example: antinib alone. Monitor<< liver>> enzymes before initiation of and periodically throughout treatment

card.plain: It lights up on the first part of liver or nerve toxicity words in warning sections, before the word is finished.
